findings: Hounsfield Look Up Tables (LUTs) are used to convert raw CT data into Hounsfield units (HU), which are standardized values for tissue density.
Water is assigned a value of 0 HU, and air is assigned a negative value (approximately -1000 HU).
Different tissues and materials have distinct Hounsfield values, such as fat (20-40 HU), bone (1000 HU), and lung tissue (-950 to -1000 HU).
The Hounsfield Look-Up Table is essential for converting raw CT data into interpretable grayscale images using the Hounsfield scale.
The scale ranges from -1000 to +1000, with water at 0, air at -1000, and bone at +1000.
